title: UK GDP first quarterly estimate, July to September 2026 (ONS, 07:00 London / 02:00 ET) — the Bank's forecast quarter, measured one working week before the labour print that shares its window
source: EST: ons.gov.uk/releases/gdpfirstquarterlyestimateukjulytoseptember2026, fetched direct 2026-10-18 (HTTP 200) — the ONS release-calendar entry reads 'GDP first quarterly estimate, UK: July to September 2026', 'Release date: 12 November 2026 7:00am', 'First quarterly estimate of gross domestic product (GDP)', marked 'This release is not yet published.' notes: PROPOSED BY THE uk-labour-market-2026-11-17 LANE, 2026-10-18. Why it earns a slot: Jul-Sep 2026 is the same three months as the Jul-Sep AWE/LFS window of uk-labour-market-2026-11-17, and 2026 Q3 is the quarter the July 2026 Monetary Policy Report forecasts, so this is the output-side read of the Bank's forecast quarter five days (three working days) before the wage-side read.
